Enterprise Account Executive

Autodesk is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to strategically grow and expand relationships across high-value enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for leading comprehensive account growth strategies, driving incremental revenue, expanding product adoption, and positioning Autodesk as a long-term strategic partner to customers undergoing digital transformation.
The Enterprise Account Executive will own strategic executive relationships, account planning, revenue generation, pipeline management, complex deal negotiations, and orchestration of cross-functional account teams. This role goes beyond execution: it requires the ability to refine and innovate account strategies, influence executive stakeholders, lead high-complexity commercial motions, and drive measurable business outcomes for both Autodesk and the customer.
This role is suited for an experienced enterprise sales leader who can operate with senior decision-makers, navigate complex customer organizations, lead matrixed teams, and create scalable growth opportunities across EBA and non-EBA enterprise accounts.

Strategic Account Growth
Lead and refine comprehensive growth strategies for assigned enterprise accounts, including EBA and non-EBA customers
Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned to customer priorities, Autodesk growth objectives, and long-term value creation
Identify and pursue expansion opportunities across new business units, buyer groups, personas, and use cases
Drive buyer seat expansion and product adoption across complex customer organizations
Lead QBRs, executive check-ins, and senior stakeholder engagement to review progress, business outcomes, risks, and future growth opportunities
Innovate account strategies that create scalable growth models and influence broader business outcomes
Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management
Maximize incremental revenue through upsell, cross-sell, upgraded products, new offerings, and EBA token consumption strategies
Own pipeline development, pipeline health, and forecasting accuracy for growth, expansion, and renewal opportunities
Use data-driven insights to assess account potential, customer spend trends, adoption signals, whitespace, and risk
Proactively adjust account tactics based on customer priorities, market changes, competitive dynamics, and business goals
Deliver predictable revenue performance while identifying transformational opportunities that support long-term customer and Autodesk growth
Executive Relationship Management
Build and maintain strategic relationships with C-level executives, senior decision-makers, and key influencers across assigned accounts
Adapt communication style to diverse executive audiences and manage challenging conversations with confidence, empathy, and business relevance
Act as a trusted advisor by connecting Autodesk capabilities to the customer’s strategic objectives and transformation priorities
Develop compelling executive narratives that articulate business value, ROI, competitive differentiation, and long-term partnership opportunities
Secure and maintain executive sponsorship for strategic initiatives, commercial agreements, and expansion opportunities
Complex Deal Strategy & Commercial Execution
Lead complex enterprise negotiations, including expansions, renewals, multi-year agreements, and high-value commercial structures
Build value-based business cases that quantify customer impact and support executive decision-making
Navigate procurement, commercial, legal, and stakeholder complexity to progress opportunities and mitigate risk
Mentor teams in complex deal negotiations and help shape strategic deal approaches across large enterprise opportunities
Account Team Unit / Cross-Functional Orchestration
Strategically lead partnerships with the extended sales team, Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner teams, and executive stakeholders
Orchestrate the Account Team Unit to co-develop scalable, impactful customer solutions
Align technical discovery, messaging, value proposition, and commercial strategy to customer needs
Drive accountability across internal teams through clear ownership, communication, and execution cadence
Ensure seamless post-sale handoff to Customer Success for onboarding, implementation, adoption, and ongoing relationship management
Serve as an escalation point for customer challenges and internal alignment issues
Partner with Customer Success and Consulting teams to ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from Autodesk solutions
Industry, Competitive & Business Leadership
Maintain deep knowledge of the customer’s industry, business model, transformation priorities, competitive landscape, and regulatory environment
Translate industry challenges into tailored Autodesk solutions and differentiated value propositions
Provide customer and market insights to internal Sales, Product, Strategy, and Marketing teams
Influence Autodesk’s go-to-market approach by sharing enterprise customer needs, competitive intelligence, and emerging market opportunities
Represent Autodesk as a strategic thought partner in executive-level customer conversations

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of enterprise sales, strategic account management, or consultative business development experience
Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts and driving significant revenue growth
Experience engaging C-level executives and senior stakeholders across large, matrixed customer organizations
Demonstrated ability to lead complex commercial negotiations, renewals, expansions, and multi-year enterprise agreements
Strong track record of pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and revenue attainment
Experience leading cross-functional account teams, including Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner, Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk stakeholders
Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, executive communication, and consultative selling skills

Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, platform, digital transformation, or technology solution sales
Familiarity with Autodesk’s Architecture, Engineering, and Construction customer segments and the business challenges, workflows, and digital transformation priorities within the AECO industry
Experience leading strategic customer transformations, large-scale adoption programs, or executive-sponsored growth initiatives

Position Summary Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs.

This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology.

They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges. The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships.

They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations. Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions. Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.

Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services. Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.

Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment. Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.

Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities. Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs. Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.

Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs. Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.

Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications. Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark ’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams. Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.

Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation. Qualifications Required 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency. Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.

Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time. Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting. Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally. Preferred Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.

Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools. What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness.

They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands.

This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution. EEO Statement Ironmark is an equal opportunity employer.

We are hiring on behalf of our client who is building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of global payments. Cross-border money movement remains one of the most complex, fragmented, and underserved challenges in financial services; our client addresses this at the infrastructure level for FinTech's, payment service providers (PSPs), and financial institutions powering global commerce.
The organization is seeking a senior, high-autonomy Enterprise Account Executive to drive sales of cross-border payments and banking infrastructure solutions to global fintechs and enterprise technology companies within the United States. This individual will own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through solution design, closing, and implementation—working closely with internal teams to deliver payment infrastructure that is both technically sound and commercially compelling.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in the US payments and fintech space, an established professional network, and the technical grounding to lead product conversations regarding architecture and integrations without requiring constant engineering support.

Full-Cycle Sales Ownership: Lead deals from prospecting and qualification through commercial negotiation, closing, and post-sale implementation planning.
Pipeline Generation: Leverage an existing network within the US fintech and payments ecosystem to generate and manage a robust book of business.
Technical Discovery: Engage prospects at an architectural level regarding payment rails, integration models, compliance frameworks, and treasury operations.
Solution Design: Collaborate with internal architects, compliance, and product teams to develop client-specific proposals that are technically feasible and regulatorily sound.
Commercial Negotiation: Structure pricing, contracts, and partnership terms that align with both client objectives and the organization’s business framework.
Pre-Sales Execution: Develop compelling proposals and pitch materials for a range of buyer personas, including engineering leaders, CFOs, and C-suite executives.
Implementation Support: Coordinate with onboarding teams post-close to ensure a smooth transition and successful client go-live.
Market Representation: Participate in industry conferences and client meetings to enhance the client's visibility and reputation within the ecosystem.

Professional Experience: 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience specifically within payments, fintech, or banking infrastructure.
Proven Track Record: A demonstrable history of hitting and exceeding quotas on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
Hunter Mentality: Proactive drive to find and win new business, taking genuine ownership of pipeline generation.
Industry Network: A strong, active US-based network in the fintech, PSP, and payments infrastructure space to generate immediate opportunities.
Domain Expertise: Solid working knowledge of global payment rails (SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, FPS, RTP), API-driven integrations, and compliance frameworks (AML/KYC).
Operational Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by a fast-moving "builder" environment rather than managing established processes.
Communication: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to maintain technical credibility in detailed product discussions.
Preferred Skills: Experience with stablecoins, embedded finance, or global settlement networks is highly advantageous.

High Impact: Join an organization at a critical inflection point where individual contributions are highly visible and measurable.
Ownership: Significant autonomy to drive commercial strategy and manage the full client lifecycle.
Growth Potential: Opportunity to operate within a genuinely differentiated product space that addresses a massive, underserved global market.
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a team empowered to act like founders and deliver outcomes that matter in the financial services sector.

We hire full-cycle on purpose. You will prospect into your own book, run first meetings, lead discovery, demo, navigate buying committees, and close. Our GTM Engineer feeds you warm, signal-driven opportunities; you turn them into revenue.
You will sell into regulatory affairs, quality, and compliance leaders at mid-market companies across pharma, medtech, food, cosmetics, and chemicals. Pipeline: Own a defined book of target accounts and a pipeline target. Hit it.
Full-Cycle Sales: Prospect, discover, demo, negotiate, and close. You own every stage.
Outbound Engine: Build pipeline through AI-augmented outbound (email, LinkedIn, phone, video) on accounts where the GTM Engineer surfaces strong intent signals.
Inbound Conversion: Qualify and convert inbound leads from website, events, content, and paid channels.
Discovery: Run consultative discovery with senior regulatory, quality, and compliance leaders. Understand their compliance pain, map it to our platform, and articulate ROI clearly.
Demo: Lead live product demos. Sales engineering supports on the complex ones.
Deal Navigation: Drive multi-stakeholder buying committees across regulatory, IT, procurement, and legal to closed-won.
CRM Hygiene: Maintain Salesforce as your source of truth. Every account, contact, activity, opportunity, and stage logged accurately.
Coaching: Leverage tools for call review and self-coaching. Contribute to peer development.
GTM Partnership: Work closely with the GTM Engineer to test new signals, plays, and sequences. Feed insights back into the engine.
Playbook: Help define the mid-market playbook: ICP refinement, qualification criteria, demo flow, objection handling, and pricing patterns that future AE hires will inherit.

2–4 years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 12 months of closing experience as a full-cycle AE, AE Apprentice, or SDR-promoted-to-AE.
Track Record: Proven history of hitting and beating pipeline and revenue targets.
Consultative Selling: You can run a discovery call that surfaces real pain, not a feature demo. You can read a buying committee, adapt your approach, and know when to push and when to wait.
Modern Sales Stack Fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce, Gong Engage / Outreach / Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or ZoomInfo. You can build a list, enrich it, sequence it, demo on Zoom, log it in CRM, and analyse it in Gong without needing a manual.
High AI Fluency: You use Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent daily as a force multiplier: account research, call prep, follow-up drafting, proposal generation, and competitive intel. Strong Written Communication: You can write an outbound email that does not sound like a template and does not sound like AI wrote it either. You can write a proposal that gets signed.

Self-Direction: Comfortable operating without a playbook in a fast-moving, founding-stage environment.
Language : Native or fluent business English plus at least one European language (French, Spanish, Italian, or German) preferred, to support effective engagement with prospects and counterparts in the region.

Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

Menufy gives independent restaurants a powerful marketing advantage with easy technology and a dedicated team that grows it with you.

More than 25,000 restaurant operators have trusted Menufy to build their custom-branded website, drive direct online orders, run pro-level marketing (email, text, loyalty, AI review replies, and Google SEO), and keep it all running with a dedicated Success Manager and 24/7 U.S.-based multilingual support.

At Menufy, we do the heavy lifting so owners can focus on what they do best: running a great restaurant.
We're looking for driven sales professionals who are excited to bring that advantage to independent operators across the country. You'll be selling a product restaurant owners genuinely need, backed by a team that makes you look great after the sale. This is your chance to build a career where closing deals helps small businesses thrive.
The Opportunity
This is a coaching-first, metrics-driven leadership role for someone equally comfortable running a pipeline review and getting on a tough call alongside a rep. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales, you will own the full performance lifecycle of your team — from hiring and ramp through sustained quota attainment and long-term development.

You will also serve as a critical bridge between Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, and Customer Success to deliver a seamless prospect-to-customer experience.

Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 8–10 Account Executives to exceed individual and team sales goals through impactful coaching, motivation, and skill development. Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by implementing recognition programs, accountability-driven incentives, and team-building practices that keep energy high and attrition low.

Address performance issues promptly and constructively using a data-driven approach. Recognize and replicate top performer behaviors — and manage underperformance with clarity, documentation, and care.
Sales Strategy and Execution: Use sales data and KPIs to diagnose team performance and adjust strategy in real time. Drive day-to-day operational excellence by keeping the team focused on key metrics including activity levels, pipeline health, conversion rates, and quota attainment against the ARR target. Own accurate forecasting and deliver regular performance reporting to the Director of Sales.
Problem Solving and Operational Efficiency: Be deeply involved in day-to-day team operations — actively troubleshooting deals, removing blockers, and ensuring reps stay focused on selling. Take a proactive approach to identifying and resolving challenges that impact team productivity, whether internal process gaps or client-facing friction.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing on lead quality, campaign feedback, and MQL-to-SQL conversion. Serve as the voice of the frontline — surfacing competitive intelligence, objection trends, and market insights to leadership.

Adaptability: High energy, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written. You see ambiguity as an opportunity, not an obstacle.

Role Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.
Responsibilities Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders
Requirements Must Have 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.
As a Senior Business Development Manager (f/m/x), you’ll drive high-impact initiatives directly for the CRO and COO. Moving fluidly between strategic growth and operational excellence, you will open new advertiser relationships, revive paused accounts, and launch entirely new verticals from scratch. There is no fixed playbook here: you’ll write it as you go balancing cold outreach and commercial negotiations with RevOps projects designed to automate and scale our Revenue team.
At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you value impact, data-led decisions, and ownership, let's talk.
In this role you will: Value-creation strategy: Develop a structured value creation plan to prioritize high impact growth levers for partners, while owning the full sales pipeline from prospecting and negotiating commercials to bringing campaigns live and scaling them.
Reactivation & Account Optimization: Systematically diagnose why paused or underperforming accounts are missing their full potential. You’ll build and execute tailored commercial and technical recovery plans collaborating with internal teams and clients to close performance gaps and bring advertisers back to scale.
New Vertical Launches: Take new verticals from idea to first revenue, mapping demand, understanding geo, payment and legal framework, and landing the first reference partners.
RevOps & Enablement: Run "special" projects that make the commercial org faster, from automating manual workflows to codifying best practices and playbooks for the Account Management team.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Legal & Compliance, Finance and Account Management to unblock deals, shape integrations and hand over accounts cleanly once they're live.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Build the business case yourself, model deal economics i.e. CPI, ROAS, revenue share, LTV and use performance data to structure partnerships that work for the partner and for exmox.
Product Voice & Advocacy: Translate what you hear in the market into prioritized, revenue-driving requirements for the roadmap.
What You Bring Relevant Experience: 5-7 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or B2B sales, with a proven history of personally initiating and closing high-impact deals.
"Swiss Army Knife" Profile: You're a builder and a generalist. You're as comfortable opening a new market as you are documenting a process, and you don't wait for someone to define the scope for you.
Commercial Hunter Mentality: A "sales-driven" personality obsessed with moving the needle; you are constantly asking "how can we double these numbers?" to drive exponential growth.
Data-Driven Mindset: Highly analytical, comfortable in spreadsheets and BI tools, able to turn raw performance data into a commercial argument and a clear next step.
Process & Automation Instinct: You notice repetitive work and remove it. Hands-on experience with CRM, no-code automation or AI tooling to scale your own output and the team's is a strong plus.
Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English with the interpersonal "spine" to challenge partners' assumptions and stand your ground during tough negotiations.
Ambitious & Goal-Oriented: A self-starter with high "eagerness" who doesn't just meet targets but proactively seeks ways to exceed them.
Nice to have: Management consulting background (e.g., Bain, BCG, McKinsey) combined with business development for a tech scale up.
Nice to have: Sales experience within adtech, gaming, rewarded user acquisition industry.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. “Not my job” isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Title : Account Director - Enterprise Business Unit
Department : Client Services

Employment Type : Full Time
Reports To : Portfolio Account Director, Enterprise Business Unit
Who We Are
Clever Digital Marketing (CDM) is a performance marketing agency trusted by the largest home improvement companies across North America. We specialize in scaling client growth through full-funnel paid media strategies and deep business consulting. CDM’s success is powered by its industry-leading reputation for exceptional service delivery and performance, with growth driven almost entirely by client referrals and expansion.
Our Enterprise Business Unit (EBU) partners with home improvement industry leaders managing $500K+ monthly ad budgets. These are high-touch, high-value, performance-obsessed clients. We operate as strategic advisors to them, integrating deeply with their internal teams to drive measurable growth through not only paid media strategy and execution, but also sales enablement, customer experience, and long-term profitability.
Our agency thrives on accountability, transparency, proactive leadership, and results — and we’re looking for leaders who do too.
The Opportunity We’re seeking a high-performance Account Director to lead enterprise-level accounts and client relationships with a deep sense of ownership, authority, and drive .
You’ll be in the driver’s seat — serving as the face of the agency and a strategic growth partner to your clients. This role is not for the passive or reactive. You’ll push boundaries, challenge thinking, and anticipate problems before they arise, guiding both clients and internal teams with confidence and clarity.
Operating at the intersection of strategic consulting, performance marketing and analysis, and client leadership , you’ll oversee as many as 3–5 large-scale accounts, each representing multimillion-dollar marketing investments, and play a key role in driving measurable business growth for your clients and for CDM.

Client Leadership & Strategic Advisory
Serve as the primary strategic partner for up to 3–5 enterprise clients ($500K+/month ad spend), driving performance, alignment, and strategic direction.
Act as the primary executive-level advisor for enterprise clients, driving performance, alignment, and strategic direction.
Proactively push client thinking and agency performance , challenging assumptions and guiding toward scalable profitability.
Lead data-driven performance reviews, highlighting insights from ROAS, CPL and conversion rates, to down-funnel sales metrics.
Anticipate client needs, staying several steps ahead with proactive communication and clear recommendations.
Build deep, trust-based relationships with VP and C-suite leaders.
Guide clients with confidence and empathy, challenging thinking when needed to drive results.
Growth & Retention
Own account retention, growth, and revenue forecasting.
Identify opportunities for cross-channel growth and lead upsell conversations with credibility.
Forecast risks early and course-correct quickly, aligning internal teams to deliver solutions.
Lead renewal and expansion conversations with clarity and confidence.
Performance Insight & Decision-Making
Diagnose funnel performance across paid search, paid social, landing pages, and CRM pathways to uncover root causes and optimization opportunities.
Partner with analytics and media teams to connect marketing data to business outcomes.
Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable insights (not just reports) that drive executive-level decisions for your clients.
Leadership & Team Collaboration
Lead cross-functional teams across media, creative, CRO, and analytics to deliver high-impact, performance-driven campaigns.
Model extreme ownership, proactive initiative, and clarity under pressure — the behaviours that build client and team confidence.
Take full ownership of all client meetings, ensuring every touchpoint demonstrates strategic progress and delivers clear value through actionable insights, data analysis, and well-structured narratives.
Operate with a builder’s mindset — identify gaps, create resources, and develop frameworks or tools that enable scalable delivery without waiting for direction.
Mentor and develop the account team, helping refine processes and contributing to the continued evolution of CDM’s Enterprise Unit.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

You’re a driven strategic operator and relationship leader with the composure of a consultant and the hunger of a performance marketer who’s comfortable in high-pressure situations.
You believe in ownership, love solving hard problems, and naturally take initiative. You inspire confidence because you do the work, not just talk about it. You’re:
Proactive & Accountable : You don’t wait to be told; you anticipate and act.
Analytical & Commercial : You connect data with business outcomes intuitively.
Assertive & Empathetic : You push when it’s right, and listen when it matters with confident humility.
Calm & Composed : You thrive in fast-paced environments, lead with clarity under pressure, and communicate with polish.
Coachable & Growth-Minded : You see feedback as fuel, not criticism.
A Nature Leader with Presence : You lead with confidence and presence while building trust and collaboration with clients and agency teams alike.
A Builder at Heart: You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves, bringing structure to ambiguity and creating the clarity, tools, and direction that enable your clients and teams to perform at their best.

6+ years of client-facing account leadership experience within performance-driven sectors.
4+ years in a performance marketing or agency environment.
2+ years of supervisory experience.
Proven experience managing $500K+/month accounts with VP/C-suite visibility.
Strong understanding of paid digital media and interpreting full-funnel performance data.
Demonstrated success driving retention, upsell, and proactive client engagement.
Confident communicator, storyteller, and polished presenter, comfortable in executive rooms.
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or analytics (or equivalent experience).
Demonstrated drive, curiosity, initiative, and self-direction; thrives in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness and ability to travel to the United States on a quarterly basis to represent the company at conferences, lead client engagements, and support key relationship-building initiatives
Bonus: Experience in home improvement, home services, or lead generation.

Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)
Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.
Company-provided MacBook computer
Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started
Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!
The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Enterprise Client Success team
A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

Director of Business Development – Due Diligence Services (Environmental + Building Sciences)
Sales Territory: Midwest (Chicago, Minneapolis, Detroit, Indianapolis, St. Louis, Kansas City, Columbus, and surrounding markets)

Bureau Veritas is seeking a Director of Business Development to drive regional growth across our full Due Diligence service platform throughout the Midwest.
This role is focused on expanding new business tied to both environmental and property condition assessments that support commercial real estate transactions including acquisitions, refinancing, dispositions, development, and portfolio management across a relationship-driven and steadily active region.
This position serves as the face of Bureau Veritas ’ integrated due diligence offering , bringing together environmental, building sciences, and specialty consulting services. The Director will partner with lenders, private equity, owners, developers, brokers, and legal advisors to deliver clear, defensible insights that keep deals moving.
This is a true growth role - strategic, territory-focused, and relationship-first. If you understand how deals come together across the Midwest where trust, responsiveness, and consistency win business - you’ll thrive here.
Due Diligence at Bureau Veritas
Bureau Veritas supports commercial real estate and infrastructure transactions by delivering comprehensive due diligence solutions that evaluate both environmental and physical asset risk.
Our services inform underwriting, investment decisions, regulatory compliance, and long-term asset strategy for regional and national portfolios - supporting clients across office, industrial, multifamily, retail, healthcare, and specialty asset classes throughout the Midwest.
You will be selling Bureau Veritas ' full Due Diligence platform:

Phase I Environmental Site Assessments (ASTM / AAI-compliant)
Phase II Environmental Investigations
Transaction Screen Assessments (TSAs)
Environmental Desktop Reviews
Vapor Intrusion Assessments
Radon Testing & Mitigation
Lead-Based Paint & Asbestos Surveys
Environmental Compliance Reviews
Remediation & Risk Management Support
Portfolio & Programmatic Environmental Due Diligence

Property Condition Assessments (PCAs)
Facility Condition Assessments (FCAs)
Capital Expenditure (CapEx) Forecasting
Engineering & MEP System Evaluations
Structural Assessments
Roofing & Building Envelope Assessments
ADA Compliance Reviews
Seismic Risk Assessments
Accessibility & Life Safety Evaluations

Energy Audits & Sustainability Assessments
ESG / Climate Risk & Resilience Consulting
Construction Risk Management
Project Monitoring & Draw Inspections
Cost Segregation Support (in coordination with partners)
Portfolio Advisory & Multi-Site Due Diligence Programs

Leads sales strategy and execution for full-service due diligence offerings across the Midwest territory.
Drives new business aligned to commercial real estate transactions , including acquisitions, refinancing, dispositions, and development projects.
Builds and expands relationships with lenders, private equity firms, developers, owners, REITs, brokers, and legal counsel active across Midwest markets.
Positions Bureau Veritas as a single-source partner for environmental and property condition risk evaluation.
Translates both environmental and physical asset risk into actionable insights that align with deal timelines.
Collaborates closely with technical teams across environmental and building sciences to ensure scoping accuracy, speed, and quality delivery.
Identifies and qualifies high-value prospects, converting opportunities into long-term client relationships.
Partners with senior sales leadership to advance and close strategic opportunities.
Develops and executes a territory-specific sales plan , including pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue targets.
Establishes strong market presence across key Midwest hubs by embedding within the CRE transaction ecosystem.
Maintains awareness of market trends, pricing dynamics, and competitor offerings.
Travels throughout the Midwest region (up to ~25%) for client meetings, site visits, and industry events.

s.h: Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in a related field preferred
s.t:
2–5+ years of experience in business development, sales, or client management within due diligence, environmental consulting, engineering, or CRE services
Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Proven experience selling due diligence services (PCA, Phase I, Phase II, or related consulting services)
Strong understanding of how both environmental and physical risks impact deal execution and underwriting
Experience working with commercial real estate stakeholders (lenders, investors, developers, etc.)
Ability to navigate complex, relationship-driven sales cycles

Für unseren Mandanten, einen international aufgestellten, mittelständischen Hersteller technischer Textilien, suchen wir eine gestandene Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die neue Märkte und Anwendungen in Europa erschließt.
Die Position ist neu geschaffen und wird aus dem Home-Office heraus besetzt, mit regelmäßigen Präsenztagen am Hauptstandort in Sachsen.
Aufgaben
Sie verantworten den Vertrieb und die Erschließung neuer Märkte für den Produktbereich technischer Textilien.
Sie identifizieren neue Anwendungsfelder in den Branchen Bau, Kosmetik, Composites oder Interior und gewinnen Neukunden in ganz Europa.
Sie betreuen Ihre Kunden eigenständig und ganzheitlich, vom ersten Kontakt über Muster und Tests bis zur Vertragsverhandlung, mit Unterstützung des versierten Vertriebsinnendiensts.
Sie stimmen sich eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Produktion ab und entwickeln individuelle Kundenlösungen.
Sie führen Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen durch und analysieren gezielt neue Kundenbedarfe.
Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen auf internationalen Messen und bei Kunden vor Ort.
Qualifikation
Sie bringen ein technisches oder kaufmännisches Studium bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit, etwa in Textil-, Werkstoff- oder Kunststofftechnik oder Chemie.
Sie verfügen über Vertriebserfahrung im Bereich erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte, idealerweise im internationalen Kontext.
Sie konnten bereits Erfahrung im Produktbereich technischer Textilien sammeln.
Sie denken unternehmerisch, arbeiten selbstständig und treten souverän gegenüber Entscheidern auf.
Sie kommunizieren sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Sie bringen eine Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Europas mit (etwa 50%).

Sie übernehmen eine neu geschaffene Rolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum.
80.000 - 100.000 EUR p.a. zzgl. variabler Anteil

Connectima ist eine spezialisierte Personalberatung, Headhunter und Executive-Search-Partner für Verfahrenstechnik und Filtration.

Wir begleiten Fach- und Führungskräfte auf ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt, im DACH-Raum und international, entlang der gesamten Bandbreite dieser Branchen: von Membranfiltration, Prozessfiltration und Wasseraufbereitung über mechanische, chemische und thermische Verfahrenstechnik bis hin zu verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Armaturen, Ventilen und Wärmetauschern.

Unser Netzwerk umfasst mehr als 40.000 Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Chemie, Pharma, Maschinenbau und Umwelttechnik. Als reine Branchenspezialisten kennen wir die Unternehmen, Technologien und Entscheidungswege im Detail und beraten Sie persönlich, vertraulich und mit echtem technischem Verständnis.

SOCi is redefining how multi-location enterprises achieve local and AI search visibility with the world’s first agentic workforce.

Built specifically for distributed brands, SOCi’s brand-trained agents are guided by a unified visibility engine that autonomously executes and optimizes local marketing work across AI search, GEO ecosystems, social, and reviews — ensuring every location is visible, discoverable, and growing in today’s geo-driven landscape.

Trusted by leading brands like Ford, Ace Hardware, and Liberty Tax, and recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, SOCi transforms marketing from software you manage into work that gets done — intelligently, consistently, and at scale.

We’re looking for a results-driven Account Manager to focus on expanding and retaining revenue within our existing client base. This role partners closely with our Customer Success Managers, who own day-to-day client relationships, to identify growth opportunities and manage all aspects of upsell and renewal negotiations.

You’ll play a critical role in driving revenue expansion by executing renewal strategies, negotiating contracts, and ensuring a smooth, timely process from proposal to signature.

Build and execute account plans to drive growth and retention across SOCi’s commercial multi-location customer base.
Cultivate deep, long-term relationships with executive stakeholders and decision-makers within your accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor, ensuring clients maximize value from SOCi’s platform and services.
Represent SOCi at customer-facing events, industry conferences, and strategic account reviews.
Serve as a subject matter expert on localized marketing at scale, helping clients solve complex challenges with SOCi solutions.
Partner cross-functionally with customer success, product, and marketing to deliver exceptional customer experiences.
Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to expand SOCi’s footprint within existing accounts.
Use SOCi’s internal tech stack (CRM, enablement, marketing tools) to manage your business effectively and track client health.
Maintain strong forecasting accuracy, pipeline discipline, and accountability to growth targets.
Deliver compelling business cases and presentations that articulate the ROI of SOCi to client executives.
Focus on solving business challenges through innovation, while keeping a customer-first mindset.
Remain adaptable as client needs evolve, supporting additional initiatives as required.

3-5+ years of experience in a quota carrying Account Management or Sales role preferably in a B2B or SaaS environment.
Ability to prove consistently hitting or overachieving quota.
Proven success in contract renewals, negotiations, and upselling to existing clients.
Property management industry experience strongly preferred, with an understanding of multi-site portfolio dynamics, resident/tenant experience priorities, and the marketing and reputation challenges unique to property management brands.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities—especially working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, and Legal teams.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with experience managing multiple deals simultaneously.
Multi-location brands experience and existing industry contacts/relationships preferred.
Self-starter with a creative entrepreneurial spirit.
Refined and proven sales methodology.
Creative strategist; develop new ways to drive sales and value to existing and prospective clients.
Experience working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.
Creative problem solver with the ability to understand and resolve prospective client challenges/objections.
Adaptable; able to quickly learn new technologies and processes.
Salesforce or equivalent CRM experience.
SOCi expects to pay a base salary in the range of $70,000 - $90,000 USD base plus commission. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Upon posting, applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Led by a team of industry experts, SOCi is leading the pack in agentic marketing for multi-location brands. Our passionate team of SOCialites work from home around the globe!

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.
Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.
From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.
With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?
Location: Manchester, THG ICON 1, WA15 0AF (Hybrid)
About THG Nutrition
THG Nutrition is home to some of the best loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, and its family of brands, Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries; to power and empower those who want more.
Why be a Senior National Account Manager at Myprotein?
We are looking for a commercially driven Senior National Account Manager to lead and grow Myprotein’s presence within the UK Convenience channel. This role will be responsible for developing strategic partnerships with key convenience retailers and wholesale groups, delivering sustainable sales growth, and expanding distribution across a fast-growing category.
The successful candidate will have strong FMCG or consumer health experience, a proven track record managing national retail accounts, and the ability to build long-term customer relationships in a highly competitive market.

s.h: As a Senior National Account Manager (Convenience) you will
s.t:
Own and manage key Convenience channel accounts including symbol groups, wholesalers, travel retail, and impulse-focused retailers.
Deliver annual sales, profit, and distribution targets across the channel.
Develop and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) aligned to wider commercial objectives.
Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, promotional plans, new listings, and range reviews.
Identify growth opportunities within protein, wellness, functional nutrition, and snacking categories.
Work closely with category, marketing, supply chain, and demand planning teams to optimise account performance.
Analyse sales data, market trends, and customer insights to drive commercial decision-making.
Manage forecasting and promotional planning to maximise availability and minimise risk.
Build strong relationships with buyers, category managers, and key decision-makers across the convenience landscape.
Support the expansion of Myprotein’s retail footprint within emerging convenience and impulse channels.

s.h: What skills and experience do I need for this role?
s.t:
Proven experience in National Account Management within FMCG, sports nutrition, beverages, health & wellness, or snacking categories.
Strong understanding of the UK Convenience retail landscape.
Experience managing major convenience, wholesale, or impulse retail accounts.
Demonstrated success delivering revenue growth and commercial targets.
Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills.
Strong analytical and forecasting capability.
Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Commercially minded with an entrepreneurial approach to growth opportunities.
Desirable Experience
Existing relationships with UK convenience retailers and wholesalers.
Experience within challenger brands or high-growth businesses.
Knowledge of sports nutrition, functional health, or performance products.
Experience working with Booker, Co-op, Spar, WHSmith Travel, Bestway, or similar retail groups.

Does your heart beat for cutting-edge IT and client advisory? Join us and inspire leading international companies with our services and solutions!

Are you professionally connected to the CG&S industry and eager to help clients thrive at one of the world's leading consulting and technology companies? Are you passionate about sales-driven client advisory and ready to take full ownership of your own account? Then find your path to Accenture!
As part of our Client Account Team, you will be the central interface between "your" CG&S clients and Accenture's operational business units across different types of services (consulting, technology, business process outsourcing). In this role, you will expand our project portfolio with the client and, as a Relationship Manager, ensure optimal outcomes and the highest levels of client satisfaction across ongoing projects.
Your goal: identify the client's strategies and priorities, match them with the broad range of services Accenture offers, put together the best possible proposition, and deliver tangible value to the client.
At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive - with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together
**Your Daily Work**
* **Build client relationships.**
You proactively engage with (potential) clients and respond to tenders with the goal of generating additional project business.
* **Coordinate the proposal process.**
Focusing on value proposition, added value, strategic fit and related topics, you coordinate and orchestrate the proposal process as the central quality authority - acting as a key point of contact both internally and externally, including for existing clients in the context of ongoing projects, such as in Steering Committees (SteerCos) or during escalations.
* **Drive positive business growth.**
In short: through your planning and management activities, you contribute to the positive portfolio and business development of both the client and Accenture.

The Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We’re a passionate, high-performing group of go-getters who act as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups around the world.

We take a consultative approach to sales—identifying business gaps, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping operators reduce reliance on third-party networks. We believe in the power of hospitality, and we’re proud to partner with businesses to streamline operations and deliver magical guest experiences every day.

As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with restaurants and hospitality groups to understand their business needs and recommend the best-fit SevenRooms solutions—from reservations and table management to online ordering and marketing automation.

You’ll drive new business by adding operators to the platform and working closely with our onboarding and account teams to ensure a smooth and enthusiastic transition. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline . Identify and engage prospective restaurants and hospitality groups to grow your book of business.
Showcase the Platform. Present the value of SevenRooms through compelling demos and conversations that help operators understand how we can support their success.
Lead Sales from Start to Finish. Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to negotiation, contracting, and go-live support.
Deliver Live Product Demos. Conduct live, engaging product walkthroughs both virtually and in person when needed.
Be a Trusted Partner. Build strong relationships with prospects and clients, always advocating for their success and acting as a true advisor throughout the process.

You have 3+ years of experience in hospitality technology sales
You’re confident presenting to clients both in person and virtually
You’re self-driven and comfortable working independently, whether in the office or remotely
You’re tech-savvy and quick to pick up new tools and platforms
You’re results-oriented and bring energy and focus to your daily work
You’ve worked with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or similar systems
You have a background in hospitality or restaurants (a big plus!)
You’re open to occasional travel into key markets to connect with clients face-to-face

About SevenRooms
In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.
With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.
In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.
As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

Leading a sales team at Uber Eats means moving fast in a competitive landscape where the real world and digital commerce intersect. As a Sales Manager for our Restaurant team, you aren't just managing a pipeline; you are building the engine that powers local economies by connecting merchants to millions of users.

You will lead a high-performing team of Account Representatives and Account Executives, guiding them through the grit of outbound prospecting and the complexity of high-stakes negotiations to bring the best local favorites onto our platform.
This role is for a leader who thrives in ambiguity and finds energy in the \"messy\" reality of scaling a business. You will need to balance strategic commercial planning with deep, hands-on coaching, often making tough calls under pressure to hit ambitious revenue targets. If you are a resilient, people-first leader who can turn shifting market dynamics into an actionable roadmap and inspire a team to exceed their own expectations, this is where you'll grow.

Lead and develop a high-performing team of Sales Representatives, using commercial coaching to unblock their pipelines and accelerate their career growth.
Navigate shifting market priorities and internal complexity to set geo-level commercial strategies that drive new business acquisition and revenue.
Manage sales lifecycle execution with urgency, from monitoring healthy pipeline forecasting to assisting your team in closing high-value, complex deals.
Collaborate across Operations, Marketing, and Product teams to resolve blockers, optimize workflows, and deliver restaurant partner solutions that scale.
Drive a culture of accountability and excellence, conducting deal reviews and performance calibrations to ensure the team consistently hits or exceeds monthly goals.
Adapt to evolving market trends and competitor offerings, using data-driven insights to troubleshoot sales tactics and improve the merchant experience.

5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience (high-volume, lead generation, or outbound prospecting).
2+ years of experience leading commercial teams
Experience in client-facing roles or leading teams in commercially-adjacent operations.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional work experience.
Fluency in French and English are mandatory

Proven track record of coaching underperforming team members to exceed ambitious revenue targets.
Analytical proficiency in Salesforce, SQL, or Google Sheets to identify market opportunities and improve team velocity.
Experience managing a mix of both Inside Sales and Field Sales teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong professional storytelling and communication skills with the ability to influence senior executive audiences.
A resilient mindset with a passion for the restaurant industry and local merchant success.
Please note that this role does not include a company car. However, all business travel is fully covered by Uber, with 100% of eligible business travel expenses reimbursed.
